import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

/**
 * Variant 1: Uses Scanner for input and System.out for output.
 */
public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        java.util.Scanner scanner = new java.util.Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        TaskC solver = new TaskC();
        solver.solve(1, scanner, out);
        out.close();
        scanner.close();
    }
}

class TaskC {
    public void solve(int testNumber, java.util.Scanner in, PrintWriter out) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int m = in.nextInt();
        if (n > m) {
            int t = m;
            m = n;
            n = t;
        }
        int[][] f = new int[n][m];
        int res = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        int cur = 0;
        int step = 1;
        int numFree = n * m;
        rec(n, m, f, res, cur, step, numFree, out);
    }

    private void rec(int n, int m, int[][] f, int res, int cur, int step, int numFree, PrintWriter out) {
        if (numFree == 0) {
            out.println(n * m - res);
            return;
        }
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < m; y++) {
                if (f[x][y] == 0) {
                    int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0, 0};
                    int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1, 0};
                    f[x][y] = step;
                    int newNumFree = numFree - 1;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                        int nx = x + dx[i];
                        int ny = y + dy[i];
                        if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < m && f[nx][ny] == 0) {
                            f[nx][ny] = step;
                            newNumFree--;
                        }
                    }
                    rec(n, m, f, res, cur + 1, step + 1, newNumFree, out);
                    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                        int nx = x + dx[i];
                        int ny = y + dy[i];
                        if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < m && f[nx][ny] == step + 1) {
                            f[nx][ny] = 0;
                        }
                    }
                    f[x][y] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
